title: Fail slot reallocation when too few replacement slots exist
description: P1 correctness: rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs find_next_available promises the same count as lost_count but returns a shorter Vec when the superframe has insufficient free slots. Callers can silently under-allocate while believing GCP conflict recovery completed. Return a capacity error unless exactly lost_count replacements are found and add a fully occupied vector test.
close_reason: Fixed: find_next_available capacity error on insufficient slots + fully-occupied regression
